$comment: Fixture household for the evals and the sandbox (WP-M). Every value is synthetic. Dates are offsets from the anchor date: "@-10d" is a date, "@-10d 15:10:00" is an America/New_York wall-clock time. Keys starting with '_' are fixture metadata and never appear in tool responses. Response field names are mapped through fieldmap.json. Render a resolved copy with: python3 evalkit/render.py resolve

position_holds._note: Deliberately incomplete for AMD. The agentic AMD position (12.5 sh) has resting sells for 15 sh (the 10-share OCO and the 5-share GTC stop), which the broker would have refused (the 5-share stop dates from when 15.5 sh were held; after last week's 3-share sale (e2) only 7.5 sh were free when the 10-share OCO went in). The state is kept on purpose so O3, G1 and G5 exercise stacked exits against the exit-guardian rule that resting sells reserve shares; no consistent shares_held_for_sells value exists for it, so AMD sell holds are left unmodeled and get_equity_positions shows AMD shares_available_for_sells 12.5 and shares_held_for_sells 0. Only KO's option-collateral hold is modeled.
